title: Species Transport (+ mixture material)
interactive: Enable the species transport model? [no] → yes; then the mixture material name (confirmed by the journal, the question text was not recorded)
notes: The mixture material must be imported from the material DB beforehand. After enabling, species-0..N equations and species BCs (Y_*) appear at the inlets. For the verified journal the mixture `mixture-material` from the `my-material` database is used.
